arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.

readerCopy.summary: A small budget adjustment makes a difficult week easier to carry.
readerCopy.body: A small budget adjustment makes a difficult week easier to carry. Someone uses a flexible fund, extra meal, open room, or changed reservation to cover a need that was about to fall through. The Moon keeps daily comfort and care on the agenda, while Venus finds the money, room, or gesture that makes the help feel personal. The sextile opens a practical route toward relief, but someone still has to offer what is available. The help matters because it reaches the person before embarrassment or exhaustion forces them to ask twice.
